root_cause: Missing or incorrect Level 2/3 commercial card data causing fee undercharging (leakage).
diagnosis: The RuPay debit transactions are being processed without proper L2/L3 data, so the gateway applies a lower fee than the modeled expected fee, resulting in a negative delta.
action_rationale: Auditing the gateway fee configuration will identify misapplied fee rules or missing L2/L3 handling that are causing the leakage.
